name: weave
description: Lattice engineering standards for Cursor: generated rules, signal-loop harvest, workflow skills, slash commands, focused agents, and in-agent guardrails.

slack_channels.description: Comma-separated Slack channel names or IDs to harvest by default.

github_org.description: GitHub org or user that owns the repos this project should watch.

tracker_team.description: Tracker team key or name when AGENTS.md declares a Tracker.

email_query.description: Default Gmail search used during harvest, for example newer_than:7d.
